## Checklist

- [ ] Stays **OSS / license-free**; no paid vendor dependency added
- [ ] Dependencies current; `npm audit` / Dependabot clean (if applicable)
- [ ] `markdownlint-cli2` passes for changed Markdown
- [ ] `az bicep build` passes (if Bicep changed)
- [ ] `terraform fmt -check` + `validate` pass (if Terraform changed)
- [ ] `PSScriptAnalyzer` clean (if PowerShell changed)
- [ ] Affected **challenge still produces its Module B evidence artifact**
- [ ] Matching **solution key** updated (if a challenge changed)
- [ ] No secrets, real tenant IDs, or real customer data
